# v1.2.15 — The App Store theme, everywhere

## The carousels finally look like the App Store

The App Store theme already had the right colours, fonts, and controls, but the
home carousels still used the old three-up grid. Now the whole layout follows
the App Store language.

## What changed

- **Carousel rails** — larger, edge-to-edge cards (~2.15 visible on a phone,
  with the next card peeking) instead of a cramped three-up row. The default
  dark and light themes keep their original sizing.
- **Carousel arrows** — the prev/next buttons stay visible on desktop and hide
  on touch devices, styled as frosted iOS glass circles.
- **Scroll indicator** — restyled as a thin iOS page indicator with a blue
  pill thumb, centred under each rail.
- **Section headers** — App Store large-title rhythm; the "View All" link is
  now Apple-blue text with a chevron instead of a tinted pill.
- **Featured cards** — the large "story" card gets rounded corners, an accent
  subtitle, and a pill Read button.
- **See-all tile** — a solid iOS card with a chevron instead of a dashed box.
- **Packs** — borderless cards with soft shadows, pill filter chips, and a
  rounded select field.
- **Novels** — the sub-tabs are now a proper segmented control.
- **Library** — history entries render as a grouped inset list with hairline
  separators.
- **Account** — stat tiles are iOS cards with system-font numbers.
- **States** — empty, error, search, and loading placeholders all use the
  theme's glass surfaces and shimmer tokens.

## Unchanged

Dark (still the default) and Light are untouched, and the App Store theme is
still opt-in under **Account → App Settings → UI Theme**. Your saved choice is
applied before the first paint, so there is no flash of the wrong theme.
